evidence.quote: We verified the calibration against the June reference plates

observations.why: Quill invokes a reference standard (June plates) as an authority against which calibration is validated — the relational move is deference to a ranked external benchmark, not communal we-ness despite the 'we'.
The summary re-encacts the same deference-to-benchmark move: calibration legitimacy is framed by appeal to a ranked reference standard rather than peer reciprocity or cost-benefit.
